solver: Newton SolverVBD / AVBD compliant ALM; native Newton collision detection
robot_control: Hardcoded bundle-position tracking during approach, then scripted Cartesian insertion; numerical IK, kinematic links, no motor dynamics
grasp: Contact and Coulomb friction only; no cable attachments to fingers or direct cable forces
connector: Initially seated; fixed kinematic boundary, models a locked connector
retreat: Open jaws, lower 27 mm to clear drooping tails, withdraw along +X, then return home
entry_feedback: At clip center plane, all six centers within bottom-local X 4..27 mm and lid-local X -2..23 mm below its flat underside. This requires crossing the rotating entrance lip; extra lateral travel is capped at world X -40 mm
insertion_path: Maintain connector-to-grip distance and target the straight cable chord at world Z 14 mm on the clip plane; all elastic deformation and contacts remain solved by Newton
